fusions.name: Reaping Stroke
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 0.5 times their remaining damage to this blow. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health, and that threshold rises with each rank. The blow deals 20 damage.

fusions.name: Wide Swath
fusions.desc: Cuts a cone 5 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything in it.

fusions.name: Chewed Over
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you, with a 10% chance of a critical heal. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Harvest Home
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
